sources.role: official WinArcadia 36.64 Windows source archive downloaded from the release page
official release page; Windows XP/Vista/7/8/10/11 32/64-bit, DirectX 9+, source and feature scope

paths.path: <WinArcadia install directory>\Configs\WinArcadia.ini (custom config names remain below Configs\)
paths.naming: Versioned line-oriented serializer with fields including version and host/controller settings; unrelated settings must be preserved
evidence: source:ibm.c sets fn_config=Configs\WinArcadia.ini and engine1.c loadconfig/saveconfig in WinArcadia-src.rar sha256=061544e10b182ad06e0e084ecd1460303917e52f4877fee9ca4fb4ab221565f

paths.path: DirectInput host joystick/gamepad devices enumerated at runtime; guest left/right controller selection is held in WinArcadia configuration state
paths.naming: The source exposes two guest ports, host-device assignment and an interactive Rearrange Gamepad Buttons dialog; no independently validated Lunchbox serializer has been implemented
evidence: source:ff.c DirectInput device enumeration and DIJOYSTATE polling in WinArcadia-src.rar sha256=061544e10b182ad06e0e084ecd1460303917e52f4877fee9ca4fb4ab221565f
source:wa-modal.c RearrangeDlgProc and engine1.c button[2][8] serializer in WinArcadia-src.rar sha256=061544e10b182ad06e0e084ecd1460303917e52f4877fee9ca4fb4ab221565f

paths.path: The selected game/media directory; WinArcadia saves guest program data in the attached media format
paths.naming: No universal host-side game-save sidecar is established by the source archive; media extensions are machine/game dependent
evidence: source:WinArcadia engine/media and file-kind tables in WinArcadia-src.rar sha256=061544e10b182ad06e0e084ecd1460303917e52f4877fee9ca4fb4ab221565f

paths.path: <game path with extension replaced by .COS>; automatic names include AUTOSAVE.COS and QUICKSAV.COS
paths.naming: WinArcadia saved-state files use the COS extension and are selected through Save State/QuickSave UI
evidence: source:ibm.h COS file filter, ibm.c AUTOSAVE.COS, gui.c QUICKSAV.COS and engine2.c KIND_COS handling in WinArcadia-src.rar sha256=061544e10b182ad06e0e084ecd1460303917e52f4877fee9ca4fb4ab221565f

paths.path: No external BIOS file is required for the Arcadia 2001/VC 4000 machine cores documented on the release page; game/program media is user supplied
paths.naming: The source archive does not publish a single mandatory BIOS filename/checksum for these machines
No external cryptographic key file is consumed by the WinArcadia host contract

windows.notes: The official release page identifies WinArcadia 36.64 as a Windows DirectX 9+ multi-emulator/assembler/disassembler with keyboard, joystick, gamepad, paddle, mouse and trackball support.

linux.reason: WinArcadia 36.64 is distributed as a Windows binary and its source uses Win32/DirectInput APIs; no native Linux host runtime is published.
evidence: source:ff.c and ibm.c Win32/DirectInput source in WinArcadia-src.rar

linux-flatpak.reason: No WinArcadia Linux binary or Flatpak package/manifest is published by the official release page.

macos.reason: WinArcadia 36.64 is distributed for Windows and no native macOS host runtime is published.

controller_boundary.refusal: Do not invent a WinArcadia controller writer: DirectInput device identity, guest-port assignment and the game-specific Rearrange Gamepad Buttons state require runtime probing and a verified serializer; the source archive alone is not enough for safe profile mutation.

notes: The source archive was inspected and hashed, but Windows launch and effective controller input were not runtime verified. WinArcadia's COS state files are game/core-version dependent.
